meanings.note: only when answering or making a phone call
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
He has a powerful inner resilience.
This is the internal order of our institution.

meanings.note: pointing at something a little way off
вон отсюда! = get out of here!

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.
In short, girls, listen to me.

meanings.en: to guess, to work out, to think of

examples.trans: Why didn't I think of it at once!

meanings.note: affectionate form of дочь; also used by older people to address a young woman

examples.trans: I listened to the recording of the conversation.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

examples.text: На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
examples.trans: At huge speed the car crashed into the building!
This is an old, beautiful building.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

отключить.gloss: to switch off, to cut off

перевернуть.gloss: to tip over, to turn over

meanings.en: to tip over, to overturn, to flip

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.
examples.trans: On Moskovskaya Street someone tipped over the rubbish bins.
The cat tipped over the water bowl.

meanings.note: подписать приказ = to sign an order

examples.text: А Клавдия Викторовна приказала сделать ей массаж ног!
examples.trans: And Klavdia Viktorovna ordered me to give her a foot massage!
The general ordered the gates to be opened.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.
The toilet is in the corridor.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
